`final class VideoResourceDecoder`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IResourceDecoder`](/reference/resources/iresourcedecoder/), [`IResourcePlayback`](/reference/resources/iresourceplayback/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.decoder.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [VideoResourceDecoder.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/decoder/impl/VideoResourceDecoder.java)

Plays a video file with FFmpeg, its frames into a texture and its sound through the audio bridge.

## Description

[`VideoResourceFormat`](/reference/resources/videoresourceformat/) picks it for MP4, Matroska and AVI files.
The first decode waits for the FFmpeg natives ([`VideoNatives`](/reference/resources/videonatives/)); a video that is not a plain file, inside a jar, a stream or a URL, is copied into the `video` area of the cache folder first.
Frames are decoded ahead on a thread of their own and shown at the time of the JOID clock; the sound plays when an audio bridge is registered, otherwise the video plays silent with one warning.
Get it from [`Resource.getPlayback`](/reference/resources/resource/#Resource-method-getPlayback) and cast it to set the sound; each fork of the same file plays on its own.

## Properties

| Property | Type | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| [loop](#VideoResourceDecoder-property-loop) | `boolean` | `false` | If `true`, the video starts again at the end. |
| [autoplay](#VideoResourceDecoder-property-autoplay) | `boolean` | `true` | If `true`, the video starts once its first frame is uploaded. |
| [volume](#VideoResourceDecoder-property-volume) | `float` | `1F` | The volume of the sound, on 1; `0F` mutes it. |
| [audioGroup](#VideoResourceDecoder-property-audioGroup) | `Object` | `null` | The group of the audio source, which the audio bridge can use to set the volume of every sound of a group at once; `null` for none. |
| [referenceDistance](#VideoResourceDecoder-property-referenceDistance) | `float` | `5F` | With a `location`, the distance from the listener under which the sound plays at full volume. |
| [maxDistance](#VideoResourceDecoder-property-maxDistance) | `float` | `50F` | With a `location`, the distance from the listener at which the sound fades out completely; in between, the volume falls as `(1 − t)²`, `t` going from 0 to 1 between the two distances. |

<a id="VideoResourceDecoder-method-decode"></a>

### decode

`void decode(ResourceData resource)` 

**Throws:**

- `UncheckedIOException`: The video … cannot be read
- `IllegalStateException`: The video … cannot be decoded

Waits for the natives, opens the video, reads its size, rate and length and decodes its first frame.
Throws the exception of the natives when they cannot be installed, `UncheckedIOException` when the video cannot be read or copied, and `IllegalStateException` when it cannot be decoded.

### play

`this play()` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Starts the video from the start, or from the time of a `seek` made while stopped, or resumes it after `pause()`.
Called before the decode ends, it starts the video once the first frame is uploaded.
